text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen, where the Umamusume she 
admired gather. The dream Hishi Miracle 
spoke of there was—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It was to "win even without a dream." 
Because someone like her—with no great 
ambitions or nobility— can still win, she 
can give dreams to others.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bearing a multitude of small expectations 
in place of her own dream, Hishi Miracle 
runs.
